## Publications

```{r,message=F,echo=F,warning=F}
#| results: asis

library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(data.table)
library(here)

df<-readxl::read_xlsx(here("pubs","pubs.xlsx"))%>%
  data.table()

# Fix Unicode escape sequences from xlsx encoding
fix_unicode <- function(x) {
  if (!is.character(x)) return(x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2014>", "\u2014", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2013>", "\u2013", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2019>", "\u2019", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2018>", "\u2018", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+00A0>", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\u00a0", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2212>", "\u2212", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+202F>", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("<U\\+2009>", " ", x)
  # Also replace actual unicode characters with HTML entities
  x <- gsub("\u2014", "&mdash;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2013", "&ndash;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2019", "&rsquo;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2018", "&lsquo;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2212", "&#8722;", x)
  x <- gsub("\u202f", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\u2009", " ", x)
  x
}
df <- df[, lapply(.SD, fix_unicode)]

if (nrow(df) == 0) stop("No publications found in pubs.xlsx")

gluefun <- function(df) {
  has_abstract <- !is.na(df$abstract) & nchar(trimws(df$abstract)) > 0
  toggle <- if (has_abstract) {
    glue('<span class="pub-sep">&middot;</span><button type="button" class="pub-toggle collapsed" data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#collapse{df$short_id}" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse{df$short_id}">Abstract</button>')
  } else { "" }
  abstract <- if (has_abstract) {
    glue('<div class="collapse" id="collapse{df$short_id}"><div class="pub-abstract">{df$abstract}</div></div>')
  } else { "" }
  print(glue('

::: {{.pub}}
[{df$title}]({df$link}){{.pub-title}}

[{df$authors}]{{.pub-authors}}

[{df$journal}<span class="pub-sep">&middot;</span>{df$year}{toggle}]{{.pub-venue}}

{abstract}
:::

'))
}

# newest first
df[order(-as.numeric(year), -as.numeric(date))] %>%
  split(seq_len(nrow(df))) %>%
  walk(gluefun)
```
